description: Fetch an account's newest posts, about 20 a page with `next_cursor` for older ones; or, with `community_url`, the latest posts in a community, one window. Each post has its text, created_at, public_metrics (likes, reposts, replies, quotes, bookmarks, views), media, hashtags and mentions. Give exactly one of `username` or `url` or `community_url`. Costs 13 credits (3 with `community_url`), cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

community_url.description: A community's URL, `https://x.com/i/communities/<id>`: its latest posts.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

username.description: The account's username. A leading @ is fine.

name: get_x_posts
title: Get an X account's or community's posts
